objectives.objective_text: કૃતિ-પરિચયમાં અપાયેલી માહિતી પરથી કવિ હરિકૃષ્ણ પાઠકની ઓળખ કરવી અને કવિએ 'જીવમાં જીવ આવ્યો' રૂઢિપ્રયોગ પર જ આખું સોનેટ કેમ રચ્યું છે તે સમજાવવું.
કવિ કઈ પંક્તિઓમાં પવન-ડમરી શમી જવા અને પહેલાં ઝીણાં ફોરાં ઝરવાથી પક્ષીના નીડ અને પર્ણો પર થયેલી અસર બતાવે છે તે શોધવું.
તાતા તાપમાં ધીરે ધીરે ચાલતા રાફડા અને સોને-રૂપે જડિત તડકાનાં ચિત્રો દ્વારા કવિ ધરાના ફૂટવા આવેલા નવા રૂપને કઈ રીતે બતાવે છે તે સમજાવવું.
કવિ કઈ પંક્તિમાં વગડાને ટહુકતો, સ્મરણને મ્હોરતું અને દૂધને ભાંભરતું બતાવીને નિર્જીવ-અમૂર્તને સજીવ કરે છે તે શોધી, સજીવારોપણ અલંકાર ઓળખાવવો અને એની અસર કહેવી.
છેલ્લી બે પંક્તિમાં 'એનું એ સૌ છતાંયે' કહ્યા પછી પણ કવિ 'જીવમાં જીવ આવ્યો' કેમ કહે છે તે સમજાવવું અને શીર્ષકની યથાર્થતા ચર્ચવી.

notes: GENRE + UNIT: 01_meta.json diagnoses સૉનેટ with high confidence (active_genre_profiles: ['sonnet.md']) and the chapter's own કૃતિ-પરિચય names both the સોનેટ form and the મંદાક્રાન્તા છંદ. explanation_unit_map.md and sonnet.md agree the unit is ભાવ-ખંડ-wise, 'never couplet-wise', with 'two to four' movements per chapter and the ceiling at four. This file cuts the fourteen printed lines into four ભાવ-ખંડ (M1.S2.T2–T5), not seven couplets and not one single topic — see the line-range rationale below.

NO [[ભાવ-ખંડ]] MARKERS EXIST IN 00_chapter_normalized.md, and that is correct per sonnet.md itself: 'Where the page prints groups, they are evidence, not the unit' — the seven printed couplets are typesetting, not the boundary, and unlike કડી (marked by refrain shorthand) or ઘટના (marked by scene shifts), a સૉનેટ's ભાવ-ખંડ boundary is a semantic judgement Agent 2 makes by reading the sentence-syntax, not a boundary the rendered page marks for Agent 1 to flag. The chapter carries only [[કવિ-પરિચય]] and [[કૃતિ-પરિચય]] markers before the unmarked verse block, and both are accounted for (folded into M1.S1.T1, see next note) — no marker anywhere is left unaccounted, and no topic is cut where no marker sits for the two markers that do exist.

LINE-RANGE MAP for Agent 5 (original_chunk stays empty here by mandate, but the cut must be unambiguous): the printed verse runs 14 lines, punctuated with પૂર્ણવિરામ/ઉદ્ગારચિહ્ન at the ends of lines 2, 4, 6, 8, 12 and 14 — every cut below lands exactly on one of those sentence-boundaries, per sonnet.md's 'cut where the syntax closes, not where the line ends'. M1.S2.T2 = lines 1–4 ('વંટોળાતી પવન-ડમરી...' through '...ઊજળો રંગ કાઢ્યો.') — the storm settles, the first drizzle falls and the idiom 'જીવમાં જીવ આવ્યો' is stated once at line 2, then નીડ and પર્ણો react. M1.S2.T3 = lines 5–8 ('તાતા તાપે ખદખદી...' through '...રૂપ ખીલ્યું ધરાનું.') — the રાફડો's slow climb and the તડકાનું સોને-રૂપે settling, ending on ધરાનું ફૂટવા આવેલું રૂપ. M1.S2.T4 = lines 9–12 ('ટ્હૌકી ઊઠ્યો તરત વગડો...' through '...કાચી ઘડીમાં !') — વગડો, સીમ, ગાણાં, પૂર, સ્મરણ, દૂધ and લોકો, the poem's widest collective picture. M1.S2.T5 = lines 13–14 ('આઘે-ઓરે, અડખે-પડખે...' through '...જીવમાં જીવ આવ્યો !') — the ચોટ, alone, exactly as sonnet.md's hard gate requires: 'The last two printed lines appear in the same topic's original_chunk, in order, and that topic is the last verse topic of the chapter,' never merged with the eight or ten lines before it. Read in order, M1.S2.T2 through T5's original_chunk values (once Agent 5 fills them) must reconstruct the printed poem character for character with no gap and no overlap — this is the mechanical test sonnet.md sets for a finished cut. The printed attribution line ('સૂરજ કદાચ ઊગે'માંથી) belongs inside M1.S2.T5's original_chunk, per sonnet.md's 'attribution belongs to the LAST topic' rule.

WHY FOUR, NOT TWO OR THREE: the four boundaries above are the poem's own sentence-boundaries and also mark four distinct pictures — (T2) birds and leaves' first response, (T3) insects and light readying the earth, (T4) the wild, the field and the people's collective celebration, (T5) the closing paradox — which also walks straight through 01_meta.json's own guiding_question ('વગડો, સીમ અને માણસો — બધામાં કયો બદલાવ આવે છે?'): વગડો and સીમ and લોકો all land inside T4, the topic that most directly answers it. A three-topic cut (merging T2+T3, or T3+T4) was considered and rejected: T3's રાફડો/તડકો pair and T4's વગડો/સીમ/લોકો pair are different scales of the same transformation (small creatures and light, versus the whole landscape and its people) and merging them would bury one picture inside a topic double its length, which is exactly the 'burying under eight earlier lines' failure sonnet.md warns the ચોટ against — the same discipline is kept for the middle topics. One topic for the whole poem (also a legitimate answer per sonnet.md) was rejected because this poem's four sentence-groups are genuinely four separable pictures, not one unbroken move.

INTRO TOPIC MERGE: 00_chapter_normalized.md carries [[કવિ-પરિચય]] and [[કૃતિ-પરિચય]] as two markers, but per agents/02_structure.md ('Std 10's unlabelled કવિ/લેખક-પરિચય + કૃતિ-પરિચય paragraph is printed for the student and is a CONCEPT topic' — singular) and the precedent already set in output10/ch01/02_structure.json for this exact std-10 book, both markers fold into ONE CONCEPT topic, M1.S1.T1. The two markers are one continuous printed unit at std 10 (an author-bio paragraph immediately followed by a work-intro paragraph, with no separating heading on the page), not two separate reading scenes.

SHABDA-SAMAJUTI AND EXERCISE APPARATUS ARE NOT TOPICS: everything from [[શબ્દ-સમજૂતી]] onward — the સમાનાર્થી/તળપદા/વિરુદ્ધાર્થી/રૂઢિપ્રયોગ/શબ્દસમૂહ sub-blocks, the four-tier [[સ્વાધ્યાય: ...]] ladder, [[સ્વાધ્યાય: વિદ્યાર્થી-પ્રવૃત્તિ]], [[ભાષા-અભિવ્યક્તિ]] and [[શિક્ષકની ભૂમિકા]] — is apparatus/exercise territory per global_content_rules.md rule 7 and explanation_unit_map.md's apparatus rule, already recorded in 01_meta.json's exercise_inventory. None of it is cut as a topic here; it stays for Agent 10, and feeds key_terms/craft evidence for Agents 5/12 (the ભાષા-અભિવ્યક્તિ box's own repetition-series and 'વગડો ટહુકે ખરો? સ્મરણ મહોરે ખરાં? દૂધ ભાંભરે?' observation is the direct textual evidence behind O4's સજીવારોપણ naming below).

SAJIVAROPAN IN O4 IS TEXT-GROUNDED, NOT INVENTED: the chapter's own [[ભાષા-અભિવ્યક્તિ]] block asks 'વગડો ટહુકે ખરો? સ્મરણ મહોરે ખરાં? દૂધ ભાંભરે?' — pointing straight at lines 9–12 giving non-living/abstract things (વગડો, સ્મરણ, દૂધ) the actions of living beings. Std 10 permits naming અલંકાર (craft-naming gate, reference/teaching_lens_map.md), so O4 names સજીવારોપણ on this evidence, following the exact shape given in agents/02_structure.md's own std 9–10 example ('...સજીવારોપણ અલંકાર ઓળખાવવો અને એની અસર કહેવી'). No other અલંકાર or છંદ beyond the book's own printed 'મંદાક્રાન્તા' (already recorded in 01_meta.json, not repeated in any objective here) is asserted anywhere in this file.

DIFFICULTY: M1.S1.T1 is 'easy' — plain prose paragraph, no verse decoding. M1.S2.T2 is 'medium' — the opening imagery is concrete (a settling dust-storm, drizzle, nests, leaves) even though 'વંટોળાતી', 'ઠરીઠામ' and 'થૈ' need conjunct/તળપદા decoding. M1.S2.T3 and M1.S2.T4 are 'hard' — sonnet.md itself calls this the densest verse in the whole pack for an L2 reader, and these two topics carry the thickest concentration of it: compound sound-words ('ખદખદી', 'ફૂટું ફૂટું ફરફર', 'ટ્હૌકી') in T3, and the named-device line (વગડો/સ્મરણ/દૂધ personified) plus a four-line single sentence in T4. M1.S2.T5 is 'medium', not 'hard': its vocabulary (the idiom, 'આઘે-ઓરે', 'અડખે-પડખે') is dvirukt/already-introduced rather than new, even though the concessive paradox it argues is analytically demanding — that demand is carried by O5's Evaluate bloom_level and the recall ladder, never by inflating difficulty for length or exam-weight alone, per agents/02_structure.md's explicit 'exam length alone — a long answer is not a hard scene' caution. All five topics still carry objectives/recall reaching Analyze or Evaluate regardless of difficulty — difficulty is not a Bloom cap.

DEPENDS_ON: [] everywhere except M1.S2.T5, which lists M1.S2.T2 — per sonnet.md's 'depends_on runs forward, and sparingly... one link, not a chain,' the ચોટ topic is the one place real dependence exists: T5's closing line answers and completes the idiom T2 first states at line 2 ('જીવમાં જીવ આવ્યો'), now returned to after the poem's middle widens outward. M1.S1.T1 (intro) is not listed as a dependency of M1.S2.T2 — following the same reasoning already recorded in output10/ch01/02_structure.json, the poem is a complete, self-standing text; the intro precedes it in reading order (which the segment sequence already captures) without being a real prerequisite for understanding the verse.

MODULE/SEGMENT SHAPE: one module (chapter is three printed pages holding a single poem, no second large movement to justify M2) with two segments — S1 the pre-reading intro, S2 the poem's four ભાવ-ખંડ — mirroring the shape already used for this same std-10 book in output10/ch01. No third segment or extra module was invented to pad a genuinely short chapter.

No numbers appear in any module_name, segment_name, topic_name or objective_text; all id/provenance numbering lives in the id fields only, per global_content_rules.md rule 4 and reference/naming_conventions.md.
original_chunk is left empty on every topic per this agent's mandate — Agent 5 transcribes it from the rendered pages using the line-range map above, not this file.
